### Added

- (agent-platform) [Split the model page into Overview, Usage and Details tabs](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2998) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A model's page under Customize has `Overview`, `Usage` and `Used by` tabs (no Details tab: Technical details sit at the foot of Overview). It names the tool that manages the model under `Managed by`, shows the HelmRelease behind a Helm-managed one, and a model agents cannot use says what is wrong and what to do under `Agents cannot use this model`.
- (agent-platform) [Attach images to a session message by paste, drop or picker](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3013) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Paste a screenshot into a session's message box, or drop image files onto it, to send them to the agent; they show in the conversation as thumbnails that open at full size. There is no button to pick a file. Agents on the Claude Code or Codex runtime, or on a provider kagent passes no images to, say they `cannot take images`.
- (muster) [Name connectors by their display-name annotation](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3012) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A connector with a `ui.giantswarm.io/display-name` annotation shows that name wherever it is named: Customize's Connectors list, connector and tool pages, the command palette, the agent wizard, agent and session pages, Usage, workflows and sign-in prompts. Search finds either name, and connectors that would read alike keep their technical names.
- (ui-react) [Check form fields on blur, re-check them live while in error](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3005) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Agent Platform forms such as the new agent wizard's Details step, `Connect a model`, adding a skill and the connector wizard check a field when you leave it instead of only on `Continue`, and a shown error clears as soon as the field is fixed.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Check the remaining form fields on blur and keep buttons pressable](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3006) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Running a tool or workflow, `Edit as JSON`, `Create cluster`, `Delete cluster`, renaming a session, the new agent wizard's Tools step and updating the agents using a skill keep their button pressable and show the problem at the field, worded as what to enter, e.g. `Enter a name for the session.`
- (agent-platform) [List ModelConfigs per namespace when the cluster-wide list is forbidden](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3020) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For a person allowed to read kagent resources only in some namespaces, the new agent wizard lists the models in those namespaces instead of saying it could not read them, so a model can be picked.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.3.0...v3.4.0
